name: Bench2Drive-Map
description: Bench2Drive-Map evaluates models' ability to interpret map data and driving/navigation instructions, grounding textual instructions to map features and navigation actions. It measures spatial understanding, route planning, and interface-level grounding on map-centric inputs. The benchmark is intended to test multimodal reasoning between textual directions and map visuals.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage among navigation and mapping research groups.
